title: Protocols and extensions
hints: Look at the README's 'New syntax' (protocol, `: P` conformance, extension). The three TODO comments mark the three spots.

Idea: Book declares `: Describable` and supplies `summary` as a computed property; `shout()` goes in an `extension Describable` so every conformer gets it; `isEven` is a computed property in `extension Int` that uses `self`.
Example on other data: `extension Priced { func priceTag() -> String { "$\(cents / 100)" } }` and `extension Int { var squared: Int { self * self } }`.
Near-answer: inside Book, `var summary: String { "\(title) by \(author)" }`; in the extension, `func shout() -> String { summary.uppercased() + "!" }`.
